title: Audit a messy production dataset for data leakage and distributional defects
brief:
You are auditing a customer churn prediction dataset containing 250,000 subscriber accounts and 45 raw features before it is fed into an automated retraining pipeline. The existing model claimed a 99.4% ROC-AUC in cross-validation, but when deployed to production, churn intervention campaigns yielded zero actual impact.

Your task is to write a systematic data audit and exploratory data analysis specification in Python/Pandas that flags all forms of target leakage, train-test contamination, impossible values, and skewed distributions, detailing how each flaw must be remediated.
deliverables: A checklist of target leakage red flags (features populated only after the churn event occurs, such as cancellation_survey_score, refund_processed_date, or account_status='closed')
A key uniqueness and merge cardinality check to ensure user_id is unique and not creating hidden cartesian explosion during feature joins
A missingness audit distinguishing Missing Completely at Random (MCAR) from Missing Not at Random (MNAR), with appropriate imputation strategies
Outlier and anomaly detection rules for negative tenure, 9999 sentinel codes, and future timestamp lookahead errors
A clean split architecture (time-based cutoff vs random split) ensuring no temporal leakage from future customer actions into past predictions
Code snippets in Python/Pandas implementing automated validation assertions that fail CI/CD if leakage features or severe drift are detected
